glosses: Utiliser un bipasse pour court-circuiter un fluide.

examples.text: On est obligé d'utiliser une vanne à trois voies qui permet de bipasser le circuit de chauffage.

glosses: A road that passes around something, such as a residential area or business district.
A replacement road for obsolete road that is no longer in use because devastating natural disasters (earthquakes, tsunamis, landslides).
The act of going past or around.
A section of pipe that conducts a fluid around some other fixture.
An alternative passage created to divert a bodily fluid around a damaged organ; the surgical procedure to construct such a bypass.

examples.text: Five of the 16 patients required simultaneous FF bypass and iliaco-femoral bypass; 2, required simultaneous FF bypass and iliac thrombo-endoarterectomy (Table II).

glosses: To avoid an obstacle etc, by constructing or using a bypass.
To ignore the usual channels or procedures.

examples.text: A team of researchers in the United States and United Kingdom say they have created the world’s first synthetic human embryo-like structures from stem cells, bypassing the need for eggs and sperm.
